turns.input: $improve $markdown Improve this planning prompt: "Help me plan our customer workshop." We are a payroll software company hosting a one-day workshop in Utrecht on 12 November for 25 HR managers from existing customers, and I use ChatGPT to draft the run-of-show. It should cover the agenda from 09:30 to 16:00, two hands-on sessions on our new leave module, lunch and a closing Q&A, plus a short prep checklist for our two trainers. We judge success by an average session rating of at least 8 out of 10 and at least 10 sign-ups for the module pilot, so the prompt must keep those targets in view. Use CRAFT, since the Target part matters to us. No questions, use your judgment where I was vague.
